_readme: A payload for the cleaning-schedule skill, for developing the cleaning team's app in
this repository without reaching the real store and without a live door code ever
being on this machine. Every code and every phone number below is invented and none
of them opens anything. The README section on this app has the two commands that turn
it into a documents file, and CLEANING_LOCAL_PATH in .env.example is where that file
is named. Dates move: edit the jobs so some of them are in the future, or the whole
fixture renders as a schedule that has already happened.
Every Thai string below is one Paul already approved, copied from where it lives: the
two note titles from 275645-cleaning.md, the cot note from the same file and from the
skill, the three names from cleaning-team.md. Where no approved string exists, the
fixture carries a Latin placeholder in square brackets and never a sentence written
here. That is the rule this file broke once and the reason it now says so: an extra
bed has no approved wording, and a fixture is not where one gets written.

cleaning.th: คิวทำความสะอาดบ้านช้างคลาน 42 ซอย1

laundry.th: คิวส่งผ้าบ้านช้างคลาน 42 ซอย1

note.th: เพิ่มเตียงเด็ก(อยู่ใต้บันได)
[TH per-clean note: an extra bed, reaching both functions]
note.en: [EN per-clean note: an extra bed, reaching both functions]
